description: Accused broke into the residence through the rear window at approximately 2:30 AM. Gold jewelry worth Rs 4.5 lakhs and cash Rs 50000 were stolen. Footprints found near the compound wall suggest entry from the adjacent vacant plot. CCTV from neighboring house shows a male figure carrying a dark bag.

Armed robbery at a mobile phone showroom on Brigade Road. Two suspects entered with covered faces and threatened the staff with a knife. Stolen items include 15 smartphones and Rs 80000 cash from the register. One suspect had a distinctive limp noticed on CCTV footage.

House break-in during daytime hours when residents were away at work. Entry through the rear window using a crowbar — tool marks found on the window frame. Jewelry box containing gold chains and bangles worth Rs 3 lakhs missing. Neighbor reported seeing an autorickshaw parked nearby for over an hour.

Physical altercation outside a bar on Lamington Road at around 11 PM. Victim sustained injuries to the head and left arm. Multiple witnesses confirm the accused initiated the fight after a verbal argument. Accused was under the influence of alcohol. Victim hospitalized for three days.

Chain snatching incident near Devaraja Urs Road market area. Accused approached the victim on a two-wheeler and snatched a gold chain worth Rs 1.5 lakhs. Victim fell and sustained minor injuries. Accused fled towards the ring road. Same modus operandi as three other incidents reported this month in the same area.

Victim received a phishing call claiming to be from the bank and was tricked into sharing OTP. Rs 2.8 lakhs transferred out of victims account in three rapid transactions to different UPI IDs. IP trace points to a VPN exit node. Similar complaints from 4 other victims in the same week suggest an organized operation.

Attempted robbery at a jewelry store in Indiranagar. Suspect matched the description from the Brigade Road robbery — similar build and a distinctive limp. Store owner activated the alarm and the suspect fled on a motorcycle. Partial registration number noted by a bystander: KA03 MR. Same knife type as the Brigade Road incident.

Police intercepted a vehicle near the port area carrying 2 kg of marijuana concealed in modified fuel tank compartment. Accused has two prior arrests for similar offenses. Informant tip led to the interception. Phone records show frequent calls to numbers in Goa and Mumbai — suspected supply chain links.

Third residential burglary in Mysuru with identical MO — rear window entry between 1 AM and 4 AM. Gold ornaments worth Rs 2 lakhs stolen. Same accused name Raju Gowda appears in case C101 and now this case. Fingerprints collected from the window frame sent to FSL for comparison with C101 samples.

Assault with a wooden stick during a property dispute. Victim sustained fractures on the right forearm. Multiple witnesses from the neighborhood confirm the dispute had been ongoing for several months. Accused had previously threatened the victim — a written complaint was filed two weeks ago but no FIR was registered at that time.

Online shopping fraud — victim paid Rs 45000 for a laptop on a fake e-commerce website. Website has since been taken down. Payment was made via bank transfer to an account that has received similar deposits from 12 other victims across Karnataka. Bank account holder address traces to a rented apartment in Whitefield that was vacated a week before the complaint.

Motorcycle theft from a parking area near the bus stand. CCTV shows the accused breaking the handlebar lock with a master key at 3:15 PM. Accused wearing a blue jacket and helmet. Same parking area has reported 5 vehicle thefts in the past two months. Security guard was not present at the time.

Another chain snatching by a two-wheeler-borne suspect near KR Circle. Matches the MO from case C105 — same approach pattern and direction of escape towards the ring road. Victim describes the suspect as medium build wearing a black helmet. This is the fourth such incident reported in central Mysuru.

Night break-in at a standalone villa in Gokulam. Accused used a heavy crowbar to pry open the kitchen grill door. Stolen silver artifacts and Rs 1.2 lakhs cash. CCTV captured an autorickshaw with registration KA09 AB 4321 idling across the street during the offense, linked to Venkatesh Naik.

Body found in an agricultural field with multiple stab wounds. Accused is the victims business partner — financial dispute over Rs 15 lakhs confirmed by bank records. Accused's phone location places him within 500 meters of the crime scene between 8 PM and 10 PM on the night of the murder. Weapon recovered from a nearby well.

Raid on a residence in Wilson Garden recovered 500 grams of cocaine and drug paraphernalia. Accused's phone records show regular contact with Salim Sheikh from Mangaluru case C108 — suspected same supply network. Cash amounting to Rs 12 lakhs found in the premises with no documented source of income. Two other occupants fled during the raid.

Local contractor received threatening phone calls demanding Rs 5 lakhs protection money. Call details traced to a pre-paid SIM purchased using forged identity documents. Voice analysis and local intelligence point to Basavaraj Hiremath, an associate of a regional extortion gang operating across Kalaburagi and Yadgir districts.

Police intercepted a courier parcel containing three country-made 7.65mm pistols and 20 live cartridges. Investigation led to Imran Khan in Shivajinagar. Ballistic cross-matching reveals similar rifling characteristics to the firearm displayed during the Brigade Road robbery case C102. Phone number shared with Suresh Kumar.

Ponzi scheme collapse involving a fake chit fund named 'Subhalakshmi Investments'. Over 150 middle-class families defrauded of approximately Rs 3.5 crores. Accused Manjunath Shenoy collected monthly deposits promising 30% annual returns before absconding. Bank accounts frozen but funds transferred to shell companies in Mumbai.

Unauthorized iron ore excavation beyond permitted lease boundaries in Sandur forest range. Satellite imagery confirms 12 hectares of encroachment over six months. Seized 8 earthmovers and 15 tipper trucks. Syndicate organized by local political functionaries using benami permits and forged transit passes.

Theft of a commercial Bolero pickup truck parked outside a wholesale market. CCTV footage confirms Arun Kamble operating with a master key, exactly replicating his method from Dharwad case C112. Vehicle GPS unit was dismantled within 10 minutes of theft near the highway toll plaza.

Phishing scam targeting senior citizens using fake pension verification SMS links. Victims clicking the link downloaded a remote access Trojan that drained their bank accounts. IP routing and server hosting details exactly match the setup used in Koramangala case C106 by Pradeep Joshi and his technical operators.

Fourth residential break-in attributed to Raju Gowda's gang. Kitchen grill cut with a portable hacksaw between 2 AM and 4:30 AM. Stolen diamond necklace and Rs 80000 cash. Footprints match the rubber sole pattern cataloged in case C101. Accused observed scouting the neighborhood three days prior.

Deepak Shetty shifting operation from chain snatching to night burglary alongside Raju Gowda. Entry gained through a balcony sliding door. Stolen electronics and gold ornaments worth Rs 2.5 lakhs. A duplicate key set and crowbar were discarded in the backyard garden.

Second narcotics seizure involving Farhan Malik while out on bail. Police recovered 1.2 kg of MDMA crystal packed inside sealed tea cartons bound for college distribution networks in Koramangala and Indiranagar. Interrogations confirm financial backing from Salim Sheikh's coastal syndicate.

Coast guard and local police joint operation intercepted a fishing boat off Bunder Harbor carrying 5 kg of synthetic narcotics. Salim Sheikh identified as the primary consignee coordinating ship-to-shore drops. Crypto-wallet ledgers recovered from his mobile device show transfers exceeding Rs 40 lakhs to foreign accounts.

Repeat violent altercation outside the exact same bar on Lamington Road involving Mohammed Irfan. Accused attacked the bar supervisor with a broken glass bottle after being refused entry due to prior intoxication issues. Severe lacerations inflicted on victims neck and chest. Accused apprehended at the scene.

Interstate vehicle theft syndicate operation. Arun Kamble stole a Royal Enfield motorcycle from Jubilee Circle. Interrogations following his capture revealed a network transporting stolen vehicles from Dharwad and Tumakuru across the state border into Maharashtra with forged registration papers.

Belagavi crime branch arrested two couriers carrying four unlicensed semi-automatic pistols inside hollowed-out wooden furniture. Couriers confessed they were hired by Imran Khan from Bengaluru to supply weapons to local extortion gangs in Belagavi and Kalaburagi.

Organized extortion ring targeting grain merchants in Kalaburagi APMC market. Basavaraj Hiremath and three armed associates threatened merchants with firearms obtained from Imran Khan's Belagavi shipment (Case C129). Collected Rs 15 lakhs in extorted funds over two weeks before police crackdown.

Broad daylight robbery at an electronics distributor in Indiranagar. Suresh Kumar and Naveen Raj threatened cashiers with country-made pistols supplied by Imran Khan. Escaped on two motorcycles with Rs 4.5 lakhs cash. CCTV clearly captures Suresh Kumar's distinctive limp and Naveen Raj's helmet design.

Economic offenses wing uncovered an illegal cryptocurrency staking platform launched by Manjunath Shenoy after his chit fund collapse. Operating under the name 'Coastal Coin', the platform duped 80 investors out of Rs 1.8 crores. Accused tracked via IP logins from a luxury resort in Goa and arrested.

Venkatesh Naik caught red-handed attempting to force entry into a ground-floor apartment using a crowbar at 3:15 AM. Alert neighbors triggered the community alarm system. Police recovered a tool kit containing master keys, crowbar, and gloves. Accused confessed to participating in three earlier Gokulam burglaries.

Ransomware attack targeting small accounting firms in Koramangala and HSR Layout. Pradeep Joshi's cyber syndicate encrypted financial databases and demanded 2 Bitcoin per company for decryption keys. Cyber police raided his apartment and seized 15 laptops, SIM boxes, and hard drives containing victim data.

Major coordinated raid shutting down the Mangaluru-Bengaluru narcotics corridor. Police arrested Farhan Malik and Salim Sheikh together at a warehouse in Bunder Port. Seized 3 kg of cocaine, 10 kg of high-grade ganja, and two vehicles used for highway transport. Syndicate dismantled.

Violent clash over the same disputed land parcel from Case C110. Vikas Hosamani accompanied by four hired goons attacked the victims family members with iron rods. Two victims suffered severe head trauma and multiple bone fractures. All accused booked under attempt to murder sections.

Raju Gowda arrested following a high-speed chase near the outer ring road after breaking into a jewelry showroom at 2 AM. Police recovered 800 grams of gold ornaments and the hacksaw used to breach the security shutters. Forensic comparison confirmed his fingerprints matched evidence collected in C101, C109, and C123.

Special investigation team executed arrest warrants for five key operators of the Reddy Brothers Syndicate. Seized financial ledgers proving Rs 18 crores of illicit revenue generated through transport of undocumented iron ore to coastal ports for export without paying state royalty.

Joint operation by Bengaluru and Kalaburagi police traced the complete arms supply pipeline connecting Imran Khan (Bengaluru) to Basavaraj Hiremath (Kalaburagi). Recovered 12 country-made firearms and 150 rounds of ammunition concealed inside an abandoned mill.

Arun Kamble syndicate fully exposed after police raided a clandestine workshop on the Tumakuru highway. Recovered 14 stolen motorcycles and 3 pickup trucks in various stages of dismantling. Engine and chassis numbers were being defaced and restamped using laser tools.

Final chain snatching incident before Deepak Shetty's capture. Accused snatched a gold mangalsutra from a woman boarding a city bus on Devaraja Urs Road. Traffic police intercepted his motorcycle at the next traffic signal after a civilian bystander raised the alarm.

Suresh Kumar and Naveen Raj arrested from a lodge in Majestic. Search of their room yielded Rs 3.2 lakhs in stolen cash, two knives, and one 7.65mm pistol. Accused admitted to executing four commercial robberies across Brigade Road and Indiranagar over a six-month span.

Court revoked bail for Mohammed Irfan after local police submitted a dossier detailing his chronic public nuisance and repeated violent assaults around Lamington Road. Accused transferred to central prison under preventive detention laws.

Forensic audit of Manjunath Shenoy's seized servers revealed an additional 200 victims across Udupi and Mangaluru who invested in fictitious high-yield real estate bonds. Total financial fraud estimated across all schemes exceeds Rs 6 crores.

Charge sheet filed in the Shankar Patil murder case. FSL DNA analysis confirmed victim's bloodstains on the clothes recovered from Shankar Patil's residence. Call detail records and cell tower triangulation definitively disprove his alibi.

Comprehensive charge sheet filed against Pradeep Joshi and four co-conspirators. Investigation established the syndicate was operating a call center simulating bank customer care, responsible for over 80 documented cyber fraud cases across South India.
Dharwad district court convicted Arun Kamble on three counts of motor vehicle theft based on CCTV evidence, master key recoveries, and witness testimony from the PB Road bus stand parking area.

Joint interrogation of Raju Gowda, Venkatesh Naik, and Deepak Shetty mapped out the complete Mysuru burglary and chain snatching network. Syndicate responsible for 12 reported residential break-ins and 6 chain snatchings across MG Road, Gokulam, and Devaraja Urs Road.

Enforcement Directorate attached commercial properties worth Rs 2.5 crores belonging to Salim Sheikh and Farhan Malik under prevention of money laundering act, derived from interstate narcotics smuggling.

Special court framed charges against Basavaraj Hiremath and arms supplier Imran Khan under organized crime provisions for running an armed extortion ring targeting commercial establishments in Northern Karnataka.
